title: Complete admin approval logic and add 'Entered By' column to all entry tables

requirements.summary: Update VerificationTab to fetch and display pending users with approval actions
acceptanceCriteria: VerificationTab fetches and displays all users with pending approval status
Each row shows the user's name, identifier, and status
Approve and Reject buttons trigger the correct backend calls and refresh the list on success

file_operations.description: Update the component to call the backend's listApprovals query (which returns UserApprovalInfo[] with principal and status fields). Filter the results to show only users with status 'pending'. For each pending user, fetch their profile using getUserProfile to display their name alongside their principal. Update the table columns to show Name, Principal, and Status. Ensure the Approve/Reject buttons call setApproval with the appropriate ApprovalStatus enum value and refresh the query on success. Handle cases where a user profile may not exist by displaying 'Unknown' as a fallback.

Add a new mutation hook useSetApproval that wraps the backend's setApproval(user: Principal, status: ApprovalStatus) method. Configure it to invalidate the 'approvals' query key on success to automatically refresh the verification list. Ensure proper error handling and loading states are exposed.

requirements.summary: Add 'Entered By' column to all entry tables displaying the user who created each record
acceptanceCriteria: Each of the listed tabs has an 'Entered By' column in its table
The column displays the name or principal of the user who created the record
Records without an 'enteredBy' value display 'Unknown' or a suitable fallback
The column is responsive and does not break the existing table layout

file_operations.description: Add an 'Entered By' column to the income records table. The backend now includes an 'enteredBy' field (string) in each IncomeRecord. Display this field in a new table column. If the field is empty or undefined, display 'Unknown'. Ensure the column is responsive and fits within the existing table layout without breaking on smaller screens.
